notes: Added parallax scrolling background with 3 layers: sky (static SKYBLUE), far clouds (0.2x speed, procedural DrawCircle clusters), mid hills (0.5x speed, custom filled half-ellipse). No textures needed — all procedural. Had to read textures_background_scrolling.c example to understand double-draw tiling technique (draw layer at X and X+tileWidth). Had to check raylib.h for DrawCircle/DrawRectangle signatures. No sqrtf lookup needed — included via raylib.h's math deps.
